_comment: DO NOT EDIT: FILE GENERATED AUTOMATICALLY BY PANEL
name: Redis 8
author: noahfaiq@gmail.com
description: Redis 8.2 (Redis Open Source, supported until Sep 2030) with password authentication, RDB + AOF persistence and graceful shutdown. maxmemory is set to 75% of the server's memory to leave headroom for forks and fragmentation.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Redis 8 installation script
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
# Safe to re-run: dump.rdb and appendonlydir are kept.
set -eu

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Always write a known-good config; keep a backup of any previous one.
if [ -f redis.conf ]; then
    BACKUP="redis.conf.bak.$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
    cp redis.conf "${BACKUP}"
    echo "Existing redis.conf backed up to ${BACKUP}"
fi

cat > redis.conf <<'EOF'
# Redis 8 configuration - generated by the installer.
# Port and maxmemory are set on the startup command line. The lines for
# requirepass, maxmemory-policy and appendonly are rewritten from the panel
# variables on every start - change them in the Startup tab, not here.

bind 0.0.0.0
protected-mode yes
port 6379
tcp-backlog 511
timeout 0
tcp-keepalive 300

daemonize no
supervised no
loglevel notice
logfile ""
databases 16

requirepass CHANGEME

# Locked-down admin features (Redis 7+ defaults, set explicitly)
enable-protected-configs no
enable-debug-command no
enable-module-command no

# Persistence: RDB snapshots + append-only file
dir /home/container
dbfilename dump.rdb
save 3600 1 300 100 60 10000
stop-writes-on-bgsave-error yes
rdbcompression yes
rdbchecksum yes
appendonly yes
appendfilename "appendonly.aof"
appenddirname "appendonlydir"
appendfsync everysec
aof-use-rdb-preamble yes

maxmemory-policy noeviction

shutdown-on-sigint default
shutdown-on-sigterm default
EOF

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Redis installation completed"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Redis Password
variables.description: Password for the default user, 16-128 characters. Allowed: letters, digits and ! # % & ( ) * + , . : ; < = > ? @ ^ _ ~ -

variables.name: Eviction Policy
variables.description: What Redis does when maxmemory is reached. Use noeviction for a database (writes fail instead of losing data) or allkeys-lru / allkeys-lfu for a cache.

variables.name: Append-Only Persistence
variables.description: yes = log every write to disk (fsync every second, at most ~1s of data loss). no = only periodic RDB snapshots (less disk I/O, more data loss on crash).
